name: 20906 · Silver Spring, MD
findings: ZIP 20906 (Silver Spring) has 197 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20906 (Silver Spring) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20906 (Silver Spring) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
